items.caption: This oracle-script form shows a central stalk with two shoots above a horizontal ground line, illustrating the analysis of 生 as a sprout emerging from soil.
items.alt: Black glyph with an upright central stalk and two curved shoots rising above a horizontal base.
items.selection_reason: The visible sprout and ground line make the proposed graphic interpretation clear.

items.caption: This bronze-script form is analyzed as retaining the sprout-over-ground structure. The account describes a lower mark beneath the sprout becoming a horizontal stroke in later forms.
items.alt: Black glyph with an upright, branching upper shape, a narrow middle stem, and a broad, irregular lower stroke.
items.selection_reason: It adds a bronze-script example that supports the sprout-over-ground analysis and helps explain the account of change in the lower part of the graph.

limitations.text: These modern vector renderings illustrate the proposed graphic analysis, but do not establish a dated sequence of individual artifacts or show that every recorded meaning of 生 developed from the sprout image.
